note: Rustic state forest campground in two wooded loops set back from the shore of Lake of the Pines, with a boat landing, a designated swimming area and a half-mile nature trail. The nearest dump station is at the forest headquarters, about 3.5 miles away. ATVs and UTVs must stay trailered inside the campground. --Claude
